name: doodle-battle-functions
description: Cloud Functions for らくがきバトル (judge, moderation, matchmaking, server-authoritative battles)

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-doodle-battle --only auth,firestore,storage "vitest run --project emulator"
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --config ../firebase.json --project demo-doodle-battle
